title: Vice-President to Visit Karnataka and Keralam on October 16
subtitle: Vice-President to Attend Commissioning Ceremony of INS Samarthak at Karwar and Inauguration of Navaratri Sargotsavam 2026 at Kozhikode
body_text:
The Vice-President of India, Shri C. P. Radhakrishnan, will visit Karnataka and Keralam on October 16, 2026. During his visit, he will attend the commissioning ceremony of the Indian Navy’s ship INS Samarthak at Karwar, Karnataka, as the Chief Guest. Later in the day, the Vice-President will inagurate the Navaratri Sargotsavam 2026 at Kozhikode, Keralam.
